fields.rationale: Adjoint temperature field introduced for the Lagrangian-based shape derivative; same polynomial space and unit as the state temperature.

expressions.name: heat_flux
expressions.rationale: Standard derived thermal flux for post-processing and for verifying the nonlinear conduction model.

optimization_config.rationale: Designed optimization configuration for the level-set shape optimization. hmin/hmax are set to 0.01/0.1 for a domain of size about 1.25 x 1.0. Diffusion=1e-4 and v0=1e-3 are standard regularisation and velocity scales. 30 iterations balance cost and convergence. The initial level set is an I-beam: full-width top flange (thickness 0.2) along the top cooling wall, bottom flange (length 0.5, thickness 0.2) under the central chip footprint, and a central web of width 0.2 spanning between them. boundary_labels contains the movable Robin cooling boundary (label 3); fixed_labels contains the chip heat-flux boundary (2), the adiabatic bottom boundary (1), and the cold-plate Dirichlet boundary (4).
